intro.title: Accordion
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build an interactive accordion component that allows users to expand and collapse content sections. You will learn how to manage component state to track which accordion item is currently open. The main technologies involved are Vue's reactive data properties and event handling with click listeners. This project will help you understand dynamic UI updates and conditional rendering in Vue.
intro.usecase: Accordions are essential UI components that help organize content in limited space while maintaining user control. You'll find them in FAQ sections of websites, where users can expand only the questions they're interested in, or in product dashboards where different data panels can be collapsed to reduce visual clutter. As a Vue developer, you'll implement accordions for settings panels, mobile navigation menus, and content-heavy forms where sections need to be revealed progressively based on user interaction.
